metadata.title: Aster outage and cadence test plan

scope.content: The plan tests 60-second cadence and latest-valid behavior during a controller outage; it does not record an executed result or substitute review for execution.

fields.requirements_links: The cadence and latest-valid requirements define observable acceptance for these planned cases.
fields.design_links: Collector, RingBuffer, Exporter, and fake-clock interfaces identify the units under test.

methods.content: Deterministic demonstration drives twelve samples and a two-minute outage while recording every accepted value and exported response.

fields.methods: Use a scheduled demonstration, FIFO boundary analysis, and exact output comparison rather than inspection alone.
fields.environment: Use fake UTC time, an in-memory buffer, a scripted valid probe, and a controllable controller-connection flag.

cases.content: The main case collects twelve valid values, drops the controller after the tenth, and checks collection and export before, during, and after the outage.

fields.inputs: Twelve values 20.0–21.1 Celsius at 60-second ticks, outage after value 20.9, and a final query after value 21.1.
fields.procedure: Record cadence and buffer after each tick, verify controller failure does not stop collection, then query after the twelfth sample.
fields.expected_results: Twelve timestamps are 60 seconds apart, the buffer holds 20.2–21.1, and final export returns 21.1 with its exact UTC timestamp.

criteria.content: Pass requires exact cadence, exact retained values and order, no export during outage, and exact latest-valid response after recovery; all remain planned expectations.

fields.pass_criteria: No missed tick, ten retained values are exactly 20.2–21.1, outage exports are suppressed, and recovery returns only 21.1.
fields.trace_matrix: Cadence maps to tick records, FIFO to retained history, latest-valid to recovery response, and read-only export to unchanged timestamps.

limits.content: The plan does not measure real scheduler jitter, physical sensor accuracy, network behavior, or multi-controller concurrency.

fields.unexecuted_cases: Every case is unexecuted in this fictional document; no transcript or observed outcome is asserted.
fields.residual_risks: Deterministic simulation cannot demonstrate embedded timing, hardware faults, transport security, or production load behavior.
